definition.//: Pre-registered 2026-11-05 by the product lead, before these sets were drawn. DEFAULT tier (blocking-eligible; its ACCEPT / shown is the headline default-tier accept rate) = the proposal's structured rule kind (lib.mjs ruleKind: conventions.yaml rule.type, rule.kind for wrapped_by, import vs other signal for avoids; never the summary text) is in default.rule_kinds AND its role has >= default.min_members members (PLAN: n >= 15 to allow blocking). SUGGESTION tier = every other shown proposal, including kinds listed in neither list and proposals without a structured rule. The not-wrong rate is reported over all shown proposals, both tiers. Amended 2026-11-05, before any held-out run (no held-out data existed): wrapped_by:jsx moved from suggestion to default (product lead).

default.//: call wrappers, decorators, base classes, required argument keys, layering (import avoidance), rendered components, rendered inside a (layout) wrapper

suggestion.//: named by the product lead: generic calls, naming, absence (any/console/bare Error and other non-import avoids), preferred libraries, ordering, file/model/package rules. Unmeasured, so suggestion tier (the default tier is an allowlist): wrapped_by:try, control, directive, throws.
